title: Topic 2.1: Hadith on Purity of Actions

pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON PURITY OF ACTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITHI
Topic 2.1: Hadith on Purity of Actions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on Purity of Actions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on Purity of Actions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on Purity of Actions in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on Purity of Actions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Purity of Actions.
4. Show that you can: read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Purity of Actions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Purity of Actions important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the Hadith on purity of action: “Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but rather He looks at your heart and actions.” (Muslim),
2. Discuss the lessons learnt from the Hadith on purity of actions and make a summary,
3. Citizenship: Information and communication skill is attained as learners brainstorm on the relevance of purity of actions in today’s society and share the findings on a chart.
4. Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained as learners read and discuss the lessons learnt from the Hadith on purity of actions.
5. Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge developed as learners brainstorm on the relevance of purity of actions in today’s society and share the findings on a chart. Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is appearance and wealth not important in the eyes of Allah?
2. What does Allah look for when rewarding His servants?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance
2. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
